cues: At a Filipino street stall, skewers of ripe fruit sizzle in brown sugar before being sold as a quick snack.
Filipino cooks serve a vivid red, sweet-savory ketchup made from tropical fruit alongside fries and grilled meat.
A history museum connects United Fruit Company railways with plantation labor disputes across Central America.
At a Caribbean bakery, ripe fruit is mashed into spiced fritter batter and fried until the edges turn crisp.
A bartender blends rum, lime, and creamy fruit puree into a frozen cocktail for a beachside happy hour.
At a Kerala tea shop, crisp slices of starchy tropical fruit are sold as salted chips beside hot chai.
